title: Bound from binary word width
statement: Let $y$ be a Boolean word of positive length and let $s$ be a natural number. If the binary representation of $s$ has length at most the binary representation of $|y|$, then $s\le 2|y|$.
hypotheses_covered: The binary representation of $s$ has length at most the binary representation of $|y|$
